other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.size:
primrec size :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "size Leaf = 0" |
  "size (Node l x r) = size l + size r + 1"
formal function definitions.size1:
fun size1 :: "'a tree \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "size1 Leaf = 1" |
  "size1 (Node l x r) = size1 l + size1 r"
formal function definitions.height:
fun height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "height Leaf = 0" |
  "height (Node l a r) = max (height l) (height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.min_height:
fun min_height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "min_height Leaf = 0" |
  "min_height (Node l _ r) = min (min_height l) (min_height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.complete:
fun complete :: "'a tree ⇒ bool" where
  "complete Leaf = True" |
  "complete (Node l x r) = (height l = height r ∧ complete l ∧ complete r)"
formal function definitions.acomplete:
definition acomplete :: "'a tree ⇒ bool" where
  "acomplete t = (height t - min_height t ≤ 1)"

formal theorem statement:
theorem acomplete_optimal:
  "⟦ acomplete t; size t ≤ size t' ⟧ ⟹ height t ≤ height t'"
